method.input: sorted synthetic series with interleaved, unique timestamps
method.parity: before timing, current timeline events are compared to a full-sort reference by instrument, priority, and timestamp
method.baseline: same quality and duplicate-instrument validation, preallocated event flattening followed by full sort; this baseline does not produce the new session index vector
method.index_aware_reference: same quality and duplicate-instrument validation, sort event/index pairs, then split ordered events and indexes
method.candidate: direct two-way merge for two markets; min-heap k-way merge with root replacement and one sift for more than two markets; both produce market/bar indexes

limitations: Synthetic timeline construction only; this does not establish end-to-end A-share backtest speedup.
Criterion samples vary with system load; the 64-market candidate interval is wider than other groups, so treat that point estimate as directional.
The synthetic timestamps are unique, so this benchmark parity check does not exercise equal-timestamp tie ordering; existing timeline behavior coverage remains the source for that contract.
No allocator counter was enabled and this does not change the nine product profile measurement statuses.
